profile.headline: Software Engineer at Benchling
profile.summary: Accomplished software engineer with experience in full stack web framework and now in an infrastructure role. Excited to improve existing infrastructure as well as innovate with new technologies. Love being challenged in new ways.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Team Lead since August 2021

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Services, infrastructure and platform team.

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description: Landing team for new Vancouver office.

positions.title: Assembly and Automation Intern
positions.description: Interned for the Assembly and Automation (robotics) team, assisted in the development of two Robot Operating System nodes to return inverse kinematic solutions for automated path planning of factory robots. Improved code quality and test coverage by unit testing classes. Refactored legacy code base to reduce redundant code and reduce maintenance costs in library, task planning, and adjacency calculator submodules.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Deployed public cloud monitoring system to data centers across the globe with Ansible. Created system with a team of five to monitor the uptime and state of public cloud servers.

positions.title: CSE Helpdesk Student Technician
positions.description: Provide technical support to students, staff and faculty in the Department of Computer Science at Texas A&M as well as imaging computers and managing printers, sound equipment and projectors.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Write, test, and analyze the performance of code run in parallel to assist in developing the Standard Template Adaptive Parallel Library (STAPL) project, which provides a framework for developers to write programs in parallel.

positions.title: CSE Helpdesk Student Technician
positions.description: Provide technical support to students, staff and faculty in the Department of Computer Science at Texas A&M as well as imaging computers and managing printers, sound equipment and projectors.

positions.title: Cashier/Concession Worker
positions.description: Sold concessions at the Silver Dollar City amusement park in Branson, Missouri. Managed cash register, prepared food, and maintained sanitation standards while working in various outdoor concession stands around the park.

positions.title: Archery Instructor
positions.description:
Instructed 5 to 14 year old boys and girls, with varying degrees of deafness in archery at a weeklong camp. Learned basic phrases and words in sign language and worked with translators to create a safe, fun and encouraged environment for campers. 

During the week, I implemented a system that gave prizes for campers who shot bulls-eyes.

positions.title: Summer Camp Counselor
positions.description:
Worked with three other counselors in a unit to care for and instruct around twenty girls ages 6 to 17 every week for eight weeks. I became certified as an archery instructor and worked in the stable to help take care of horses and teach campers how to ride.

After the first session, I was voted favorite counselor by the campers.
